title: Dense transactions table with absent and failed data
expectations: Numeric and currency columns are right-aligned; text and date columns are left-aligned.
Every column declares an explicit width rather than leaving the table to distribute space implicitly.
Columns the user was told they could sort by are actually marked sortable, and the table has a default sort.
Currency, dates and percentages are formatted through shared formatters with an explicit locale, not hand-rolled per cell.
A site that did not report renders distinctly from a site that reported zero; the two are never collapsed into the same cell content.
The failed discount feed surfaces as an explicit error state, never as a blank or a zero.
An empty result set renders an empty state that names what is empty and what to do next, not a bare header row.
Status is shown with StatusDot carrying a text label, not with a bare coloured dot or a decorative Badge.
